Printer Issue.recommendation: Continue troubleshooting first unless the printer fails a direct test print or shows a confirmed hardware error.
steps: Confirm the printer is powered on and connected directly to the PC when possible.
Run a Windows test print outside of the booth software.
Check paper, ribbon, and printer status lights.
Confirm the correct print size/mode is selected.
If using ARM, verify Hot Folder Print is being used instead of direct driver printing.
evidence: Screenshot of booth software print settings
Short video showing the failed print attempt
Printer Issue.customer_response: Thanks for the details. Please confirm whether the printer can complete a Windows test print outside of the booth software. Also send a photo of the printer status/error and a screenshot of the print settings so we can confirm whether this is a configuration issue or a hardware issue.
Printer Issue.internal_notes: Printer issues should be separated into software/configuration vs. hardware failure. Confirm test print first before recommending replacement.

Camera Issue.recommendation: Check USB, camera utilities, and Device Manager before replacing hardware.
steps: Reconnect the camera and try a different USB port.
Plug the camera directly into the mini PC instead of a USB hub.
Close Canon/Nikon/Sony camera utilities if installed.
Check Device Manager to confirm whether the camera is detected.
Test with a shorter USB cable if possible.
evidence: Video showing the camera disconnecting or failing to trigger
Screenshot of booth software camera settings
Camera Issue.customer_response: Please connect the camera directly to the mini PC and confirm whether it appears in Device Manager. Also close any camera utility software and send a screenshot of Device Manager plus a short video showing the issue.
Camera Issue.internal_notes: Camera disconnects are often USB path, cable length, power, hub, or SDK conflict related.

Touchscreen Issue.recommendation: Validate USB connection and calibration behavior before replacing touch hardware.
steps: Confirm the touch USB cable is connected to the PC.
Test whether Windows detects touch input.
Try a different USB port.
Run the touch calibration tool if available.
Check whether only part of the screen responds or touch is fully unavailable.
evidence: Screenshot of Device Manager HID devices
Touchscreen Issue.customer_response: Please confirm whether Windows detects any touch input at all, then send a short video showing the touch behavior and a screenshot of Device Manager under HID devices.
Touchscreen Issue.internal_notes: Separate calibration issue from no-detection issue. No detection may indicate cable, USB, controller, or touch foil issue.

Software / App Issue.recommendation: Collect version, device type, and screenshots before escalating.
steps: Confirm software version.
Restart the app and the PC/iPad.
Check whether the issue happens on a new event/project.
Verify required permissions and settings.
Document exact steps to reproduce the issue.
evidence: Screenshot or video of the issue
Software / App Issue.customer_response: Please send the software version, device model, operating system, and a short screen recording showing the issue from start to finish. If possible, also confirm whether the same issue happens in a new event/project.
Software / App Issue.internal_notes: Version and reproducibility matter most. Avoid escalating without exact steps and environment details.

Shipment / Missing Item.recommendation: Verify packing evidence and shipment photos before confirming replacement shipment.
steps: Identify the order/product involved.
Ask for photos of all items received.
Compare received items against the expected packing list.
Check internal shipment photos if available.
Confirm whether a replacement part needs to be shipped.
evidence: Customer photo of all received items laid out
Shipment / Missing Item.customer_response: Please send a clear photo of all items received laid out together, along with your order number. We’ll compare it against the expected packing list and confirm the next step.
Shipment / Missing Item.internal_notes: This workflow supports warehouse/process improvement. Strong photo evidence prevents duplicate or incorrect replacement shipments.
